name.ja: ねこぶそう2 てんこ盛り

description.ja: 「ねこ」フィギュアに「ジャケット」を着せ「ぶそう」パーツを装備させて楽しむ新感覚Hobby！
description.en: A new type of hobby where you can enjoy wearing a "jacket " on a " cat " figure and equipping it with " buso" parts!

description.ja: • 第１弾に続き、ねこ造形作家として活躍中の森口修氏の原型により表情や毛並み、肉球など、細部に至るまで造形。
description.en: • Continuing from the first edition, every detail including facial expressions, fur, and paws has been sculpted using the prototype by Mr. Osamu Moriguchi, who is currently active as a cat sculptor.

description.ja: • 第２弾のメカデザインは倉持キョーリュー氏が担当。動物型からマシン型へのシルエット変化の妙を発揮。
description.en: • Kyoryu Kuramochi is in charge of the second mechanical design. The silhouette changes from an animal shape to a machine shape.

description.ja: • 「ぶそう」は単独でミニメカ状態にも組み替え可能。ジャケットや各ぶそうに搭載された3mmジョイントにより組み合わせは自由自在。
description.en: • "Buso" can be rearranged into a mini-mecha state by itself. You can freely combine them with the 3mm joints installed on the jacket and each bush.

description.ja: • 複数組み合わせることで、さらに大きなねこぶそうに組み替えることができる。第１弾との組み合わせも可能。ユーザーの数だけニャスタマイズがある！
description.en: • By combining multiple items, you can rearrange them into even larger catfish. Can also be combined with the first edition. There are as many customizations as there are users!

description.ja: • 〈てんこ盛り〉は一箱で全ての「ぶそう」がそろうまさに“てんこ盛り”なセット！
description.en: • 〈Tenkomori〉 is a truly “Tenkomori” set that has all the “Buso” items in one box!

description.ja: • このセットでしか手に入らない新規造形ねこ「スコティッシュフォールド」と特別カラーの「ぶそう」に加えてボーナスパーツが入ったフルセット。
description.en: • A full set that includes bonus parts in addition to the newly sculpted cat "Scottish Fold " and the special color " Buso" that can only be obtained with this set.

contents.ja: 彩色済ねこフィギュア×1
